name: @ancientpantheon/claude-chat-shell
description: Drop-in agentic chat UI for Claude Code / Claude Agent SDK apps. One <link>, two <script>s, one mount() call — you get the whole chat box: header identity + live conversation stats, the transcript region, the compose footer with line gutter, attachments, reply quotes, model/effort/permission controls, context readout, and the Compact/Wrap context-window controls. You supply data and callbacks; the package owns every pixel.
